# Volunteer Training

Training courses for [marshalls](marshall.qmd), [officials](official.qmd) and 
[coaches](coach.qmd) plus safeguarding training courses are available from 
Swim England in partnership with the Institute of Swimming. 
Alnwick Dolphins typically covers 100% of the cost of this training, to ensure
the path to becoming a volunteer is as frictionless as possible, given their 
importance to the club.

Safeguarding training is essential for the following volunteer roles:

- [Welfare Officer](welfare-officer.qmd)

To find out more about volunteer training, speak to the club's [Workforce Coordinator]()
or the [Club Secretary](mailto:secretary@alnwickdolphins.co.uk).
